tokenizer.rules: Lowercase words, numbers and punctuation; prepends <bos>; unsupported words become <unk>

training.dataset: Original authored color/object/verb grammar plus five model-inspection sentences
training.scope: Educational grammar fixture; not a general language model
training.split: Sorted unique sentences, seeded shuffle, every seventh held out
training.determinism: Seeded CPU run; exact retraining across Torch/platform versions not guaranteed

request.prompt: a comet is cyan . the comet

capture.attention: [head][query][key]: causal post-softmax probability, before optional head-output ablation
capture.activation: [token][channel]: post-block residual; norms are L2 across channels
capture.playback: Recorded generation steps; animation does not represent execution timing
